description: Which timestamps are anchored? Flags naive local times, zone abbreviations, date-only, epoch units and d/m ambiguity — Classifies up to 200 timestamp strings as anchored (RFC 3339 with Z or offset), naive local (no offset), date-only, epoch seconds or milliseconds, zone abbreviation, ambiguous numeric date, or unparseable, and lists the hazard of each; with assumedTimeZone it also reports whether a naive time falls in a DST gap or overlap there, every instant it could mean, and offsets that contradict the zone. Bu

assumedTimeZone.description: IANA zone the producer is believed to use; used for gap/overlap and offset-consistency checks.

name: naive-timestamp-hazard
